name: branding-faint-orbit-heart-symbol-on-white-reveal-frame
title: Pale interlocking orbit-heart symbol on white, an early frame of a logo reveal
whatItIs: A white field with a small pale cream-grey symbol of two crossing loops forming a heart and an orbit.
whatItMeans: Delicate and gentle; the faint mark suggests a fade-in of care.
techniques: Start an animation with a ghost-pale mark.
Use two crossing loops to suggest heart and orbit.
Keep to a single tone on white.

vocabulary.definition: A logo shown at very low contrast.
Two loops that intersect to form a symbol.
A frame from an animated logo intro.
